core_obligations: Scheme descent (proof lines 4340-4345): the flat-lfp equivalence identifies X'/S' with a triple (X/S, Y'/T', varphi).
Module and Pic descent (proof lines 4346-4367): the QCoh-flat equivalence restricts to invertible modules, giving Pic(X') = Pic(X) x_{Pic(Y)} Pic(Y').
Small point (proof lines 4368-4387): F' with invertible pullbacks is finitely presented, and the cited fibre-wise criterion applies because the fibres of X' -> S' equal those of X -> S.
Properness both ways (proof lines 4389-4397): base change one way, thickening lemma back.
Ampleness both ways (proof lines 4399-4406): base change one way, relative-ampleness thickening lemma back.
proof_roadmap: Descend the scheme via the flat-lfp equivalence (proof lines 4340-4345).
Descend invertible modules via QCoh-flat and settle the invertibility small point (proof lines 4346-4387).
Transfer properness and ampleness both directions (proof lines 4389-4406).
